product.olivetti-netstrada-3400-plus.sum: The NetStrada Plus deployed on Puerto Rico's Vocational Rehabilitation Administration network.
product.olivetti-netstrada-3400-plus.his: A 2006 audit records 32 NetStrada 3400 Plus servers on the agency's Windows 2000 network and three more running Windows NT for its database.
product.olivetti-netstrada-3400-plus.arc: The audit distinguishes two uses for the same model. The Windows NT systems hosted an ADABAS-D database.
product.olivetti-netstrada-3400-plus.ver: The audit confirms the model. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-3400-plus.lim: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-3400-plus.ocp: Oficina del Contralor de Puerto Rico, TI-07-01, 31 August 2006, p. 5
